comment: The questions and temperament reads that have not yet been routed through weigh and liveTemperament, each with the build key that owns the routing.

Read by scripts/verify-willingness-route.mjs. It may only shrink: an owner removes its line in the same change that lands the builder and its test, or the liveTemperament read. `--closing` requires both lists empty.

The questions are the W5 contract's new members of willingness.ts's Question union. The temperament reads are the two actor modules that read the traits directly on the W5 base; 5A routes both through liveTemperament, byte-identical while no leader offset is seated.

The person-behavior wave's five questions sit here from the contract wave until each workstream lands its builder and test: certify-order and carry-out with WS-A, aim-leak with WS-C, minister-initiative with WS-D in W1, and steer-contracts with WS-D in W2.
